title: Supplier catalogues: complete source editions, customer import and recipient delivery

task.name: Receive and deliver the customer's complete supplier catalogue edition
task.purpose: Prepare a recurring supplier feed for the customer's actual PIM/import contract and selected recipient catalogue, with reusable mapping, reviewed corrections and complete independent receiving.
task.request: Continue the original customer Workshare and its agreed feed, product/byte limits, number of editions, import contract and recipient profile. Retain each complete original source before interpretation. Map exact supplier and product identifiers, numeric values, units, classifications and language/media fields into the selected customer contract. Use the initial full edition and the contracted subsequent editions with their explicit full-versus-delta semantics. Apply a supplied delta to its declared base before producing the full current catalogue. Review reasoned corrections, run the actual selected customer imports and carry each complete recipient catalogue through its schema and receiving checks. A recipient T_NEW_CATALOG contains the full current selected population.
task.completeOutput: The agreed source editions, reusable mappings, reviewed correction and catalogue history, complete current recipient catalogue for every contracted edition, and actual selected customer-import/recipient receipts. Deliver the complete versioned operator source, recorded configuration references, original source files, catalogue/customer bundle and operating guide. The named customer engineer imports and reopens the complete retained workspace, makes an agreed local correction and retains that later work when an earlier delivery is replayed.
task.repeatTrigger: A new authorized supplier edition, a reviewed mapping correction or an explicit recipient/customer requirement changes the useful catalogue. Select its original edition and scope before continuing. Reopening a retained edition or recovering its interrupted delivery continues the same operation.
task.pricedUnit: If the customer later commissions a priced merchant service, select one complete reviewed catalogue edition for the agreed population and recipient as its useful task unit. The original professional Workshare fee and milestone schedule remain separately retained commercial terms. No atomic service price, paid task, invoice, cash receipt or payment approval is derived from that quoted fee.

source.reference: Select the customer's actual complete feed and retained editions, documented PIM/import contract, and recipient specification. The maintained material-catalogue operator supplies source retention, mapping, review, BMEcat/ETIM delivery and complete catalogue receiving; bind its selected installed source release.
source.population: The complete contracted supplier/product population for each selected edition, within the original Workshare's bounds. Retain full source files and the explicit source revision, base edition, additions, changes, omissions and deletions. Every agreed full recipient delivery covers the full current selected catalogue.
source.meaning: Preserve original supplier/product keys, leading zeros, exact numbers and decimal meaning, units and conversions, language/country, classifications and versions, media references and source rights. Keep absent, blank and explicit removal distinct. Record mapping and correction reasons against the original rows. Select the actual recipient's validation rules and any licensed classification/import prerequisites.
source.changePolicy: The source owner provides each actual edition and its full-versus-delta semantics. The customer/prime selects the documented import contract and recipient profile. Retain prior source, mapping, correction, review and receiving history. Schema changes, another supplier/customer/recipient, additional editions or extra correction rounds follow the original Workshare change process.

receiving.application: The customer's selected PIM/import environment and the maintained material-catalogue workspace, browser, batch CLI and typed/MCP client. Use the actual documented import boundary supplied at commissioning; retain its version and source reference with the complete operator configuration.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Verify the complete source population and exact values; review the reusable mapping and correction workflow; carry every contracted edition through the selected customer import; validate each full current recipient catalogue; retain complete native receipts and unresolved recipient findings. Export the whole catalogue/customer bundle, import it into the named receiving workspace, perform the agreed later correction, reopen it and demonstrate preservation of that later work through an earlier-bundle replay. Resolve the original consolidated review allowance and each unchanged commercial phase criterion.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer and source owner control product semantics, source-use rights, PIM releases and recipient acceptance. The implementation operator records deliberate mapping/profile changes and withdrawal/deletion choices. Source preparation does not select private endpoint paths, proprietary schemas, licensed classifications or production activation on their behalf.
receiving.recovery: Inspect the original source, review, export and import operations before resuming. Retain complete immutable file hashes and the current source/mapping/review identities. Resume the original export/download or customer import; keep a later customer correction and history when replaying an earlier bundle. Preserve source and private workspace state outside the installed runtime.
receiving.maintenance: Name the source publisher, customer/PIM release owner, recipient acceptance owner, implementation engineer and receiving operator. Record hosting, licenses, source rights, refresh cadence, retained-state backup, rollback and the actual correction/support allowance. Use the original Workshare to agree any additional maintenance or scope.

steps.title: Receive the complete original commissioning source
steps.result: Keep the original Workshare, sender/case identities, proposed fee, milestone triggers, phase owners, effort, review allowance and full packet. Confirm actual customer, feed bounds, editions, import contract, recipient and acceptance owner before implementation.

steps.title: Retain and map the full initial edition
steps.result: Receive every original byte and its source revision. Save reusable field, identifier, number, unit, classification and media mappings with reasons and complete source references; retain actionable errors for operator review.

steps.title: Join the selected customer import
steps.result: Implement and record one actual documented import contract from the commissioning inputs. Keep the customer's existing PIM ownership, licence and deployment authority. Obtain the original receiving result from its agreed environment.

steps.title: Review and deliver each full current catalogue
steps.result: Run the original supplier review and reasoned correction workflow. Export a complete T_NEW_CATALOG when that is the agreed recipient boundary, validate it against the selected BMEcat/ETIM and recipient rules, and retain the complete receiving response.

steps.title: Continue the contracted source revisions
steps.result: Retain each next supplied edition and its declared base/full-or-delta semantics. Apply the complete changes and review omissions/deletions explicitly. Repeat the selected customer import and full current recipient delivery for every contracted edition.

steps.title: Receive the complete customer workspace
steps.result: Export full source/catalogue/correction/review history and the selected delivery files. The receiving engineer imports the complete bundle, makes an agreed local correction, reopens it and retains that newer work through an earlier delivery replay.

steps.title: Hand over operation and the agreed correction round
steps.result: Deliver complete source, mapping, configuration references and operating instructions; run the named operator walkthrough and close the original acceptance criteria. Keep unresolved source/recipient dependencies and support ownership explicit.

inputs: Complete original Workshare packet and plan digest, all phase owners/acceptance/dependencies, exact proposed fee/milestones and original effort source
The contracted complete supplier feed and editions, byte/product limits, actual full-versus-delta semantics and base-edition references
One actual documented customer PIM/import contract, approved test environment and named customer engineer; proprietary schema paths supplied by that owner
One selected recipient BMEcat/ETIM profile, language/country/party rules, current schema, permitted classification source and actual receiving access
Original product/supplier identity, exact numeric/unit/blank/removal semantics and reusable field mapping with reasoned correction rules
Selected maintained source/runtime release, private workspace/configuration references and full catalogue/customer export files
Actual source-use, license, receiving and production authority; agreed review/support allowance and commissioning start conditions
Merchant and independent buyer deployments and atomic task price only if a separately agreed paid-service operation is selected in the original case
